source.title: Simply B1 Preliminary for Schools: 8 Complete Practice Tests (2019, revised exam from 2020)

parts.title: Part 1 · Email
parts.instructions: You must answer Question 1. Read the email and write your reply using all the notes. Write your answer in about 100 words.

parts.title: Part 2 · Article or story
parts.instructions: Choose one question: Question 2 (article) or Question 3 (story). Write your answer in about 100 words. For the story, begin with the sentence given on the book page.
